name: OmniMedVQA
intro: OmniMedVQA 是大规模综合医学视觉问答基准，由 73 个真实医学图像分类数据集构建，含 118,010 张图像和 127,995 条问答，覆盖 12 种成像模态、20 多个解剖区域和五类问题。
org: University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Southeast University
build_method: 医学分类数据模板化, 反比例平衡采样, GPT-3.5改写与干扰项生成, 人工双重检查
eval_feature: 问答生成分数与前缀似然分数双轨评测, 五类医学能力与模态分析
scale: 118,010张图像, 127,995条问答, 73个源数据集, 12种模态, 20+解剖区域
build_method_en: Medical Classification Template Conversion, Inverse-proportional Sampling, GPT-3.5 Rewriting and Distractor Generation, Human Double Check
eval_feature_en: Dual Question-answering and Prefix-likelihood Scores, Five Medical Capabilities and Modality Analysis
intro_en: OmniMedVQA is a large-scale comprehensive medical visual-question-answering benchmark built from 73 real medical image-classification datasets. It contains 118,010 images and 127,995 QA items across 12 imaging modalities, more than 20 anatomical regions, and five question types.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.09181 and the official OmniMedVQA release. The diagrams preserve 73 real medical classification datasets, 12 imaging modalities, more than 20 anatomical regions, dataset-specific QA templates, inverse-proportional template sampling, five question types, GPT-3.5 semantic-preserving question reformulation, two-to-four-option distractor generation, human double checking, the 118,010-image and 127,995-item release, image-question-option prompts, free-form response-to-option similarity for Question-answering Score, per-option visual-prefix likelihood for Prefix-based Score, ground-truth comparison, and separate zero-shot reporting across question types and overall.
